paper.title: Online Resource Allocation With General Constraints

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic setting (ORA with budget and general constraints)
unmapped: Online resource allocation: the whole input tuple (reward f_t, constraint costs g_t in [-1,1]^m, consumptions h_t in [0,1]^n) is revealed BEFORE the action is chosen
Two kinds of constraints: hard budget constraints (strictly enforced) and general long-term constraints (cumulative violation bounded)
Benchmark is the dynamic optimum OPT(gamma) over action sequences satisfying the constraints, in expectation over i.i.d. inputs
A void action with zero reward, cost and consumption exists
Slater parameter rho_stoc unknown to the learner
settings.definition_quote: In the stochastic setting, the inputs are drawn i.i.d. across rounds from a fixed but unknown probability distribution $\mathcal{P}$ supported on $\Gamma$. ... we let $\text{OPT}_\text{stoc} \coloneqq \E_{\bm{\gamma} \sim \mathcal{P}^T} [\text{OPT}(\bm{\gamma})]$ be the dynamic-optimum ... $R_T := \text{OPT}_\text{stoc} - \mathbb{E}_{\bm{\gamma} \sim \mathcal{P}^T}[\texttt{Rew}(T, \bm{\gamma})]$.

settings.name_in_paper: Adversarial setting (ORA with budget and general constraints)
unmapped: Online resource allocation: the whole input tuple (reward f_t, constraint costs g_t in [-1,1]^m, consumptions h_t in [0,1]^n) is revealed BEFORE the action is chosen
Two kinds of constraints: hard budget constraints (strictly enforced) and general long-term constraints (cumulative violation bounded)
Benchmark is alpha times the dynamic optimum over constrained action sequences, alpha = rho_adv/(1+rho_adv)
A void action with zero reward, cost and consumption exists
Slater parameter rho_adv unknown to the learner
settings.definition_quote: In the adversarial setting, the dynamic-optimum is defined as $\text{OPT}_\text{adv} = \text{OPT}(\bm{\gamma})$ for a given fixed input sequence ... $\alpha\text{-}R_T := \alpha \cdot\text{OPT}_\text{adv} - \texttt{Rew}(T)$, where $\alpha := \nicefrac{\rho_\text{adv}}{1 + \rho_\text{adv}}$

symbols.M_cons: total number of constraints M = m + n (general constraints plus budgets)
symbols.rho: Slater parameter rho_stoc (feasibility margin), unknown to the learner

source.label: st_re
source.quote: Let $\delta\in(0,1)$. Consider Algorithm~\ref{alg:alg1} with learning rate $\eta = ...$. With probability at least $1 - \delta$, in the stochastic setting it holds: \[ R_T \leq \frac{1}{\beta_{\text{min}}} + \frac{60 M \sqrt{2 T \ln\left( \frac{T^2}{\delta} \right)}}{2 \beta_{\text{min}}^2} + \frac{\sqrt{T}}{120 \sqrt{2 \ln\left( \frac{T^2}{\delta} \right)}}.\]

results.notes: R_T is OPT_stoc (expected dynamic optimum) minus expected reward, yet the theorem is stated 'with probability at least 1-delta'; recorded as stated. Comparator is the dynamic constrained optimum.

symbols.M_cons: total number of constraints M = m + n
symbols.alpha_apx: alpha = rho_adv/(1+rho_adv), rho_adv the adversarial Slater parameter
